name: Being Dead Simulator
source:
Have you ever wondered how it is to be dead?

This great simulator will let you experience that, which would normally be out of human's reach.

Not only does it simulate the state of being dead, but also some (as for now) possible scenarios that may occur while being burried underground.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/being-dead-simulator/30204]Game Jolt[/url]]
